about: Every build in The Hollow Crown, designed or not. Add an entry the moment a build is asked for, even with no design yet, and move its status on as it progresses. Run  node tools/build-catalog.mjs  after editing to rewrite builds/CATALOG.md (check.mjs fails if it is stale).

statuses.designed: a design, spec or render exists (Claude Doc, hosted 3D page, or code on a branch), but not in the local asset viewer from main
statuses.in viewer: a builder on main shows it in the asset viewer (localhost:4747), not yet placed by the game
statuses.in game: the game (or the world map) places it

refine: Refine every building, region by region
skill: Build a shape-based Minecraft building skill
citadel: Redesign the Citadel as one grand layout
material: Design a repeatable material gathering loop
map: Build the plots and world map
lords: Add Rival Lord settlers, wonders and events
townsfolk: Add talking townsfolk to Kingsrest and towns
placement: Design the settlement building placement mechanic
settle: Build settlement building and mason shop
rift: Settle the road to the Rift
townhall: Build the town hall and skill tree
hollowdim: Build the Hollow dimension and Rift
hollowdesign: Design the Hollow as its own world
miniature: Build a scaled-down map in the welcome hall
lore: Write the lore, tomes and library
crown: Design the Crown takeover and Citadel
